results.name: singleton_specific_with_sparse_distractors_rate
results.description: Proportion of choices selecting the minimal-feature singleton referent satisfying the heard word, in utterance scenes where all true referents are singletons of differing feature counts and false distractors are sparse (at most 1 feature each).
results.code:
# name: singleton_specific_with_sparse_distractors_rate
# description: Proportion of choices selecting the minimal-feature singleton referent satisfying the heard word, in utterance scenes where all true referents are singletons of differing feature counts and false distractors are sparse (at most 1 feature each).
def test_statistic(df):
    obj_codes, obj_uniques = pd.factorize(df["objects"], sort=False)
    heard_vals = df["heard"].fillna(-1).to_numpy(dtype=np.int64)
    choices = df["choice"].to_numpy(dtype=np.int64)
    parsed_objs = [np.asarray(json.loads(s), dtype=np.int64) for s in obj_uniques]

    pair_keys = obj_codes * 32 + (heard_vals + 1)
    _, first_pos, inv = np.unique(pair_keys, return_index=True, return_inverse=True)

    n_scenes = len(first_pos)
    in_slice = np.zeros(n_scenes, dtype=bool)
    target_mask = np.zeros((n_scenes, 8), dtype=bool)

    for k, pos in enumerate(first_pos):
        h = int(heard_vals[pos])
        if h < 0:
            continue
        arr = parsed_objs[obj_codes[pos]]
        n_obj = arr.shape[0]
        true_mask = arr[:, h] == 1
        false_mask = ~true_mask
        if np.sum(true_mask) < 2 or np.sum(false_mask) < 1:
            continue
        fc = np.sum(arr, axis=1)
        dup_count = np.sum(np.all(arr[:, None, :] == arr[None, :, :], axis=2), axis=1)
        min_fc = np.min(fc[true_mask])
        max_fc = np.max(fc[true_mask])
        if (
            np.all(dup_count[true_mask] == 1)
            and max_fc > min_fc
            and np.all(fc[false_mask] <= 1)
        ):
            in_slice[k] = True
            target_mask[k, :n_obj] = true_mask & (fc == min_fc)

    row_mask = in_slice[inv]
    if not np.any(row_mask):
        return 0.0
    return float(np.mean(target_mask[inv[row_mask], choices[row_mask]]))

# name: duplicate_specific_referent_rate
# description: Proportion of choices selecting a minimal-feature (most specific) referent satisfying the heard word, in utterance scenes where the minimal-feature true referents are identical duplicates and a higher-feature true competitor is a singleton.
def test_statistic(df):
    obj_codes, obj_uniques = pd.factorize(df["objects"], sort=False)
    heard_vals = df["heard"].fillna(-1).to_numpy(dtype=np.int64)
    choices = df["choice"].to_numpy(dtype=np.int64)
    parsed_objs = [np.asarray(json.loads(s), dtype=np.int64) for s in obj_uniques]

    pair_keys = obj_codes * 32 + (heard_vals + 1)
    _, first_pos, inv = np.unique(pair_keys, return_index=True, return_inverse=True)

    n_scenes = len(first_pos)
    in_slice = np.zeros(n_scenes, dtype=bool)
    target_mask = np.zeros((n_scenes, 8), dtype=bool)

    for k, pos in enumerate(first_pos):
        h = int(heard_vals[pos])
        if h < 0:
            continue
        arr = parsed_objs[obj_codes[pos]]
        n_obj = arr.shape[0]
        true_mask = arr[:, h] == 1
        if np.sum(true_mask) < 2:
            continue
        fc = np.sum(arr, axis=1)
        min_fc = np.min(fc[true_mask])
        max_fc = np.max(fc[true_mask])
        if max_fc <= min_fc:
            continue
        dup_count = np.sum(np.all(arr[:, None, :] == arr[None, :, :], axis=2), axis=1)
        min_true = true_mask & (fc == min_fc)
        high_true = true_mask & (fc > min_fc)
        if np.all(dup_count[min_true] > 1) and np.any(dup_count[high_true] == 1):
            in_slice[k] = True
            target_mask[k, :n_obj] = min_true

    row_mask = in_slice[inv]
    if not np.any(row_mask):
        return 0.0
    return float(np.mean(target_mask[inv[row_mask], choices[row_mask]]))

results.name: shared_alt_feature_exhaustivity_rate
results.description: Proportion of choices selecting a minimal-feature referent whose non-heard features are all shared across multiple objects, in utterance scenes where all objects satisfy the heard word, all have at least 2 features, and competing referents possess a unique non-heard feature.
results.code:
# name: shared_alt_feature_exhaustivity_rate
# description: Proportion of choices selecting a minimal-feature referent whose non-heard features are all shared across multiple objects, in utterance scenes where all objects satisfy the heard word, all have at least 2 features, and competing referents possess a unique non-heard feature.
def test_statistic(df):
    obj_codes, obj_uniques = pd.factorize(df["objects"], sort=False)
    heard_vals = df["heard"].fillna(-1).to_numpy(dtype=np.int64)
    choices = df["choice"].to_numpy(dtype=np.int64)
    parsed_objs = [np.asarray(json.loads(s), dtype=np.int64) for s in obj_uniques]

    pair_keys = obj_codes * 32 + (heard_vals + 1)
    _, first_pos, inv = np.unique(pair_keys, return_index=True, return_inverse=True)

    n_scenes = len(first_pos)
    in_slice = np.zeros(n_scenes, dtype=bool)
    target_mask = np.zeros((n_scenes, 8), dtype=bool)

    for k, pos in enumerate(first_pos):
        h = int(heard_vals[pos])
        if h < 0:
            continue
        arr = parsed_objs[obj_codes[pos]]
        n_obj = arr.shape[0]
        if not np.all(arr[:, h] == 1):
            continue
        fc = np.sum(arr, axis=1)
        if np.min(fc) < 2:
            continue
        ext = np.sum(arr, axis=0)
        has_unique = np.any((arr == 1) & (ext[None, :] == 1), axis=1)
        min_shared = (fc == np.min(fc)) & (~has_unique)
        if np.any(min_shared) and np.any(has_unique):
            in_slice[k] = True
            target_mask[k, :n_obj] = min_shared

    row_mask = in_slice[inv]
    if not np.any(row_mask):
        return 0.0
    return float(np.mean(target_mask[inv[row_mask], choices[row_mask]]))

results.name: prior_rich_minus_sparse_oddball_diff
results.description: Difference in the proportion of choices selecting the unique singleton on no-word prior trials with one singleton and one clone group, comparing scenes where the singleton has more features than the clones minus scenes where the singleton has fewer features than the clones.
results.code:
# name: prior_rich_minus_sparse_oddball_diff
# description: Difference in the proportion of choices selecting the unique singleton on no-word prior trials with one singleton and one clone group, comparing scenes where the singleton has more features than the clones minus scenes where the singleton has fewer features than the clones.
def test_statistic(df):
    obj_codes, obj_uniques = pd.factorize(df["objects"], sort=False)
    heard_vals = df["heard"].fillna(-1).to_numpy(dtype=np.int64)
    choices = df["choice"].to_numpy(dtype=np.int64)
    parsed_objs = [np.asarray(json.loads(s), dtype=np.int64) for s in obj_uniques]

    pair_keys = obj_codes * 32 + (heard_vals + 1)
    _, first_pos, inv = np.unique(pair_keys, return_index=True, return_inverse=True)

    n_scenes = len(first_pos)
    scene_group = np.zeros(n_scenes, dtype=np.int64)
    target_mask = np.zeros((n_scenes, 8), dtype=bool)

    for k, pos in enumerate(first_pos):
        h = int(heard_vals[pos])
        if h >= 0:
            continue
        arr = parsed_objs[obj_codes[pos]]
        n_obj = arr.shape[0]
        fc = np.sum(arr, axis=1)
        dup_count = np.sum(np.all(arr[:, None, :] == arr[None, :, :], axis=2), axis=1)
        sing_mask = dup_count == 1
        clone_mask = dup_count == (n_obj - 1)
        if np.sum(sing_mask) == 1 and np.sum(clone_mask) == (n_obj - 1):
            sing_fc = int(fc[sing_mask][0])
            clone_fc = int(fc[clone_mask][0])
            if sing_fc > clone_fc:
                scene_group[k] = 1
                target_mask[k, :n_obj] = sing_mask
            elif sing_fc < clone_fc:
                scene_group[k] = -1
                target_mask[k, :n_obj] = sing_mask

    row_group = scene_group[inv]
    rich_mask = row_group == 1
    sparse_mask = row_group == -1
    if not np.any(rich_mask) or not np.any(sparse_mask):
        return 0.0
    rich_rate = float(np.mean(target_mask[inv[rich_mask], choices[rich_mask]]))
    sparse_rate = float(np.mean(target_mask[inv[sparse_mask], choices[sparse_mask]]))
    return rich_rate - sparse_rate

results.name: two_feat_unique_alt_vs_three_feat_shared_rate
results.description: Proportion of choices selecting the 2-feature referent satisfying the heard word, in utterance scenes where that 2-feature referent possesses a unique alternative feature (extension 1) while competing 3-feature true referents possess only shared features.

# name: two_feat_unique_alt_vs_three_feat_shared_rate
# description: Proportion of choices selecting the 2-feature referent satisfying the heard word, in utterance scenes where that 2-feature referent possesses a unique alternative feature (extension 1) while competing 3-feature true referents possess only shared features.
def test_statistic(df):
    obj_codes, obj_uniques = pd.factorize(df["objects"], sort=False)
    heard_vals = df["heard"].fillna(-1).to_numpy(dtype=np.int64)
    choices = df["choice"].to_numpy(dtype=np.int64)
    parsed_objs = [np.asarray(json.loads(s), dtype=np.int64) for s in obj_uniques]

    pair_keys = obj_codes * 32 + (heard_vals + 1)
    _, first_pos, inv = np.unique(pair_keys, return_index=True, return_inverse=True)

    n_scenes = len(first_pos)
    in_slice = np.zeros(n_scenes, dtype=bool)
    target_mask = np.zeros((n_scenes, 8), dtype=bool)

    for k, pos in enumerate(first_pos):
        h = int(heard_vals[pos])
        if h < 0:
            continue
        arr = parsed_objs[obj_codes[pos]]
        n_obj = arr.shape[0]
        true_mask = arr[:, h] == 1
        fc = np.sum(arr, axis=1)
        ext = np.sum(arr, axis=0)
        has_unique = np.any((arr == 1) & (ext[None, :] == 1), axis=1)
        two_feat_uniq = true_mask & (fc == 2) & has_unique
        three_feat_shared = true_mask & (fc == 3) & (~has_unique)
        if (
            np.any(two_feat_uniq)
            and np.any(three_feat_shared)
            and np.all(two_feat_uniq | three_feat_shared | (~true_mask))
        ):
            in_slice[k] = True
            target_mask[k, :n_obj] = two_feat_uniq

    row_mask = in_slice[inv]
    if not np.any(row_mask):
        return 0.0
    return float(np.mean(target_mask[inv[row_mask], choices[row_mask]]))
